series.en: Google Cloud Agentic Future: English for the Operating Layer
series.zh: Google Cloud Agentic Future：面向 AI 运行层的专业英语人格

title.en: Open standards reduce the integration tax.

subtitle.en: Learn to explain A2A-style interoperability and model-agnostic strategy in plain, executive-ready English.
subtitle.zh: 学习用清楚的高管英语解释 A2A 式互操作性和 model-agnostic 策略。

audience: Platform strategist · AI architect · Enterprise buyer-facing engineer

source.title: A2A moves to the Agentic AI Foundation
source.speaker: Rao Surapaneni

note.en: This lesson uses the A2A standards discussion as a springboard for enterprise interoperability language.
note.zh: 本课以 A2A 标准讨论为跳板，训练企业互操作性表达。

scenario.customer: A CIO worries that adopting agents from multiple vendors will create custom integrations, lock-in, and unclear coordination across systems.
scenario.weakResponse: Open standards are important because they let different agents talk to each other.
scenario.reliableResponse: I would frame open standards as a way to reduce the integration tax. If agents can coordinate through shared protocols, the enterprise gets more leverage across vendors, models, tools, cost, and governance.

principle.en: Interoperability is not a technical preference; it is an enterprise leverage strategy.
principle.zh: 互操作性不是技术偏好，而是企业杠杆策略。

flow.en: Start with the problem: every custom integration becomes long-term coordination cost.
flow.zh: 先讲问题：每个自定义集成都变成长期协调成本。

flow.en: Explain the distinction: A2A coordinates agents; MCP connects tools and data.
flow.zh: 解释区分：A2A 协调 agents；MCP 连接工具和数据。

flow.en: Translate standards into business leverage: lower switching cost, less lock-in, more provider choice.
flow.zh: 把标准翻译成业务杠杆：更低切换成本、更少锁定、更多供应商选择。

flow.en: Connect interoperability to governance and observability.
flow.zh: 把互操作性连接到治理和可观测性。

flow.en: Close with a modular future: the best enterprise agent stack will not be one closed system.
flow.zh: 用模块化未来收尾：最好的企业 agent stack 不会是一个封闭系统。

phraseBank.line: Open standards reduce the integration tax.

why.en: Integration tax is concrete and business-friendly.
why.zh: Integration tax 具体，也有商业感。

phraseBank.line: The issue is not whether agents can act; it is whether agents from different systems can coordinate.

why.en: It shifts the question from capability to ecosystem.
why.zh: 把问题从能力转到生态。

phraseBank.line: Model-agnostic architecture is a business risk strategy, not just an engineering style.

why.en: It makes neutrality strategic instead of ideological.
why.zh: 让中立变成战略，而不是立场。

meaning.en: The ability of different systems to work together reliably.
meaning.zh: 不同系统可靠协同工作的能力。

use.en: Interoperability matters when agents come from different vendors and platforms.
use.zh: 当 agents 来自不同供应商和平台时，interoperability 很重要。

meaning.en: The hidden cost of connecting systems through custom work that must be maintained over time.
meaning.zh: 通过自定义方式连接系统后，长期维护所产生的隐藏成本。

use.en: Open standards can lower the integration tax for enterprise AI.
use.zh: 开放标准可以降低企业 AI 的 integration tax。

meaning.en: Designed to work with multiple models rather than depending on one provider.
meaning.zh: 设计上能适配多个模型，而不是依赖一个供应商。

use.en: A model-agnostic stack gives the enterprise more room to optimize.
use.zh: Model-agnostic stack 给企业更多优化空间。

meaning.en: A situation where switching away from a vendor or architecture becomes difficult or expensive.
meaning.zh: 从某个供应商或架构切换出去变得困难或昂贵的状态。

use.en: Interoperability reduces lock-in by keeping coordination portable.
use.zh: 互操作性通过保持协调可迁移来减少 lock-in。

logicMoves.line: The business value of a protocol is that teams do not have to rebuild coordination from scratch every time.

why.en: It makes protocol value easy for non-engineers to understand.
why.zh: 让非工程师也能理解 protocol 价值。

intent.zh: 解释开放但不过度承诺。

logicMoves.line: Open standards do not remove all complexity, but they reduce the amount of custom glue the enterprise has to own.

intent.zh: 把互操作性连接到杠杆。

logicMoves.line: Interoperability gives the enterprise leverage across cost, latency, performance, and provider choice.

why.en: It turns a technical feature into a business portfolio argument.
why.zh: 把技术特性变成业务组合论证。

conversationLessons.en: Open standards become interesting when you explain the cost they remove.
conversationLessons.zh: 当你解释开放标准消除什么成本时，它才变得有趣。

conversationLessons.en: Vendor-neutral language sounds strongest when it is tied to risk management.
conversationLessons.zh: 供应商中立表达最有力的时候，是它和风险管理绑定。

conversationLessons.en: Interoperability is a leadership topic because it shapes future options.
conversationLessons.zh: 互操作性是领导力话题，因为它塑造未来选项。

anchor.quote: Open standards reduce the integration tax.

concept.en: A strong standards conversation explains the hidden cost of not having standards.
concept.zh: 强标准叙事会解释没有标准的隐藏成本。

examples.line: A2A matters because agents need a shared way to request work, pass context, and report outcomes.

why.en: It explains the standard through work coordination.

examples.line: The more portable the coordination layer is, the less dependent we are on any single vendor's closed path.

why.en: It sounds strategic without attacking a vendor.
why.zh: 有战略感，但不攻击供应商。

examples.line: A modular agent stack lets us choose the best model, tool, and workflow pattern for each job.

lines.line: Every custom connection solves today's problem but can become tomorrow's integration tax.

why.en: It gives the listener a memorable cost frame.
why.zh: 给听者一个好记的成本框架。

lines.line: Model-agnostic design keeps the enterprise from turning one technical choice into a long-term constraint.

why.en: It connects architecture to future freedom.
why.zh: 把架构连接到未来自由度。

lines.line: The protocol gives different agents a shared contract for how work moves between them.

why.en: Shared contract is accessible and precise.

lines.line: Open coordination still needs clear identity, permissions, and auditability.

why.en: It avoids sounding careless about openness.
why.zh: 避免把开放讲得过于草率。

lines.line: The real value is optionality: the ability to change models, tools, and vendors without rebuilding the whole system.

why.en: It gives interoperability a clear business payoff.
why.zh: 给互操作性一个清楚的商业回报。

prompt.en: Practice explaining open standards to an enterprise buyer.
prompt.zh: 练习向企业买家解释开放标准。

steps.en: A CIO asks why A2A matters.
steps.zh: CIO 问为什么 A2A 重要。

focus.en: Explain agent coordination in plain English.
focus.zh: 用清楚英语解释 agent 协调。
使用 model-agnostic 风险表达。

steps.en: The team says custom integrations are fine.
steps.zh: 团队说自定义集成也可以。

focus.zh: 引入 integration tax 框架。
